answer: Each identity claims one slipway cradle at a jetty and locks a 70-credit bond on its serial, filing a signed load reading. An auditor recomputes expected load from the cradle table and the fable tide table for the inlet; a missing, reused, or out-of-tolerance reading burns the bond. The first reading costs 31, the kth 31+6(k-1), the 1000th 6025, so 1,000 fakes pay 3,028,000 plus 70,000 locked. A rented-cradle ring fails because a rented reading carries its owner's key, and a second filing under another key triggers a double burn. An honest operator pays 31 once and recovers the bond on audit.
